text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's a board finish. I'd say 
that's a pretty great result, wouldn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Making the board really makes all the 
difference, huh? I couldn't stop staring 
at my number up there.
choice_data_list: That was such a great run!

well. It was a good match, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I hope we can keep this momentum going 
for the next one. ...Well, I certainly 
plan to give it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Aim higher... It's true that it was a bit 
of a near miss, maybe...? But—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood. There's no harm in aiming for 
1st place next time, right?!
